guideTitle: The Best Extra-Large Desk Pads for Dual Monitor Setups
breadcrumbLabel: Best Desk Pads for Dual Monitors
metaTitle: Best Large Desk Pads for Dual Monitor Setups (2026)
metaDescription: We compared extra-large desk pads and XXL mouse mats for dual-monitor desks on size, depth, material and thickness, from 35-inch mats to a 55 x 24-inch PU pad.
introParagraphs: A dual-monitor desk is usually wider than a single-screen setup, and the keyboard and mouse often sit off-center. A standard 31-inch desk pad can leave the mouse on bare desk. For these setups, width and depth matter most: a pad that runs under the monitor stands, or at least spans keyboard, mouse and a notebook.

The pads here range from 35.4 x 15.7 inches, which covers keyboard and mouse, to 55 x 24 inches, which covers most of a typical desk. Material decides feel and care: PU leather wipes clean, cloth-topped gaming mats are softer and absorb spills, and thicker mats cushion the wrists more.
Our comparison is based on published specifications and price position, not hands-on testing. Measure your desk before choosing a size.

best-desk-pads-for-dual-monitor-setups-1.summary: A 55 x 24-inch PU leather desk mat with a suede backing.
best-desk-pads-for-dual-monitor-setups-1.description:
The AFIING 55 x 24-inch mat is the one to choose if you want to cover most of the desk: PU leather large enough to sit under both monitor stands, keyboard and mouse, with a suede back for grip.

PU leather wipes clean and resists spills, which suits a work desk. It costs about $28 at the time of writing.

Measure first: at 55 inches wide it will not fit smaller desks.
best-desk-pads-for-dual-monitor-setups-1.bestFor: Wide dual-monitor desks where one pad should cover everything.
best-desk-pads-for-dual-monitor-setups-1.skipIf: Your desk is under about 55 inches wide.

best-desk-pads-for-dual-monitor-setups-2.summary: A 35.4 x 15.7-inch, 3mm cloth mouse mat for keyboard and mouse, about $13.
best-desk-pads-for-dual-monitor-setups-2.description:
The Cmhoo XXL is the budget option: a 35.4 x 15.7-inch, 3mm cloth mouse mat that covers keyboard and mouse, for about $13 at the time of writing.

It will not reach under monitors on a dual setup, but it gives the mouse room to travel.
best-desk-pads-for-dual-monitor-setups-2.bestFor: Budget setups that only need keyboard and mouse covered.
best-desk-pads-for-dual-monitor-setups-2.skipIf: You want the pad under the monitors too; choose a 47-inch or larger mat.

best-desk-pads-for-dual-monitor-setups-3.summary: A 46 x 17-inch, 5mm-thick gaming mat for extra cushioning.
best-desk-pads-for-dual-monitor-setups-3.description:
The LifeTrim is the thickest mat here at 5mm, with a 46 x 17-inch surface, which may feel softer under the wrists during long sessions.

It is wide enough for keyboard, mouse and more on a dual-monitor desk.

The thicker mat raises the keyboard slightly, and a cloth top absorbs spills.
best-desk-pads-for-dual-monitor-setups-3.bestFor: People who want a softer surface under the wrists.
best-desk-pads-for-dual-monitor-setups-3.skipIf: You prefer a thin, wipe-clean surface; the AFIING PU mats suit that.

best-desk-pads-for-dual-monitor-setups-4.summary: SteelSeries' QcK cloth mat in an XXL size.
best-desk-pads-for-dual-monitor-setups-4.description:
The SteelSeries QcK is a well-known cloth gaming surface; the XXL version is designed to cover keyboard, mouse and more.

SteelSeries says more than 10 million QcK pads have been sold.

The listing here does not state the exact dimensions, so confirm the size you are ordering. It costs about $30 at the time of writing.
specs: Size: XXL (dimensions not stated in listing)
best-desk-pads-for-dual-monitor-setups-4.bestFor: Gamers who want a familiar mouse surface on a large mat.
best-desk-pads-for-dual-monitor-setups-4.skipIf: You want stated dimensions; the Black Shark or LifeTrim list theirs.

best-desk-pads-for-dual-monitor-setups-5.summary: A 47.2 x 23.6-inch, 3mm cloth mat that covers monitor, keyboard and mouse.
best-desk-pads-for-dual-monitor-setups-5.description:
The Black Shark is the large cloth option: 47.2 x 23.6 inches and 3mm thick, deep enough to reach under a monitor stand as well as keyboard and mouse.

It is the most expensive pad here at about $36 at the time of writing, and the cloth surface is less spill-resistant than PU.
best-desk-pads-for-dual-monitor-setups-5.bestFor: Dual setups that want a soft, deep mat.
best-desk-pads-for-dual-monitor-setups-5.skipIf: You want wipe-clean PU; the AFIING 55 x 24 is similar in coverage.

best-desk-pads-for-dual-monitor-setups-6.summary: An AFIING desk mat with vegan PU leather on a natural cork base.
best-desk-pads-for-dual-monitor-setups-6.description:
This AFIING mat pairs vegan PU leather with a natural cork base, a warmer look than suede-backed pads, and wipes clean of liquids and grease according to AFIING.

The listing does not state dimensions, so check the size options. It costs about $25 at the time of writing.
best-desk-pads-for-dual-monitor-setups-6.bestFor: Buyers who like a PU top with a cork underside.
best-desk-pads-for-dual-monitor-setups-6.skipIf: You need a confirmed large size; the 55 x 24 AFIING states it.

best-desk-pads-for-dual-monitor-setups-7.summary: A 35.4 x 15.7-inch cloth mat with a waterproof nano coating.
best-desk-pads-for-dual-monitor-setups-7.description:
This 35.4 x 15.7-inch mat has a cloth surface with a nano coating that the seller says resists spills and sweat stains, a compromise between cloth feel and easier cleaning.

It covers keyboard and mouse but not monitors.

best-desk-pads-for-dual-monitor-setups-8.summary: A YSAGi PU leather desk protector for about $14.
best-desk-pads-for-dual-monitor-setups-8.description:
The YSAGi is an inexpensive PU leather desk protector that doubles as a large mouse pad and wipes clean.

The listing does not state dimensions, so check that the variant is large enough for a dual-monitor desk.
best-desk-pads-for-dual-monitor-setups-8.bestFor: Budget buyers who want PU and will confirm the size.
best-desk-pads-for-dual-monitor-setups-8.skipIf: You need a known large size; the AFIING 55 x 24 states it.

buyingCriteria.explanation: Measure your desk. 35-inch mats cover keyboard and mouse; 47 to 55-inch mats can reach under monitor stands.
PU leather wipes clean; cloth is softer and absorbs spills unless coated.
3mm is typical; 5mm (LifeTrim) is softer but raises the keyboard.
Suede, cork and rubber backs all help grip.

faq.q: What size desk pad do I need for two monitors?
faq.a: Measure the desk width and how deep your monitor stands sit. To reach under the stands, look at 47 to 55-inch mats about 24 inches deep.
Cloth is softer and suits gaming; PU wipes clean and suits office work.
Thicker mats cushion more but raise the keyboard slightly.
Rubber, suede and cork backs all help it stay put.

bottomLine: For a dual-monitor desk, the AFIING 55 x 24-inch PU mat is the choice if you want one wipe-clean pad under everything, and the Black Shark is the cloth alternative that reaches under the monitor stands.
If you only need keyboard and mouse covered, the Cmhoo and coated 35.4-inch mats are inexpensive, and the LifeTrim adds 5mm of cushioning.
